tools.name: bluesky_search
tools.description: Use for real-time social listening, brand/topic mentions and sentiment research on Bluesky: returns up to 50 public posts matching a query (supports from:handle, #tags, since:/until: dates via Bluesky search syntax) with text, author handle/display name, createdAt, engagement counts, outbound links

tools.name: bluesky_profile
tools.description: Use to look up or verify a Bluesky account: returns DID, handle, display name, description (bio), follower/following/post counts, account creation time, avatar and banner URLs, and labels. Public profile data only. Paid tool: x402 USDC on Base, $0.002 per successful call; call without payment to rec

tools.name: bluesky_feed
tools.description: Use to monitor what a specific Bluesky account has posted recently: returns up to 50 posts (original posts by default, optionally including replies/reposts) with text, time, likes/reposts/replies, outbound links and URLs. Cursor pagination supported. Paid tool: x402 USDC on Base, $0.003 per successf

tools.name: hn_search
tools.description: Use to find what Hacker News says about a product, company, library or topic: searches stories (default) or comments across HN history, sorted by relevance or newest, optionally limited to the last N days or a minimum points threshold. Returns title, URL, author, points, comment count, time, text ex

tools.name: hn_thread
tools.description: Use to read the discussion on a Hacker News post: returns the story (title, URL, points, author, time) and up to N comments in thread order with depth, author, time and plain text (HTML stripped). Good for summarising community reaction to a launch. For the live HN front page, new, best, Ask HN, Sho

tools.name: lobsters_hot
tools.description: Use to see what programmers on Lobsters are discussing right now: returns up to 25 stories from the hottest or newest page, optionally filtered to one tag, with title, URL, score, comment count, tags, submitter and time. Paid tool: x402 USDC on Base, $0.002 per successful call; call without payment

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: bluesky_search, bluesky_profile, bluesky_feed, hn_search, hn_thread, lobsters_hot · Public sink: bluesky_profile, hn_thread.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: bluesky_search, bluesky_profile, bluesky_feed, hn_search, hn_thread, lobsters_hot · Public sink: bluesky_profile, hn_thread

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
